─ by ElektroStudios
╭─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ Purpose:                                                                                │
│   This application normalizes line endings (CRLF / CR / LF) in your CS and VB files.    │
│                                                                                         │
│   It scans the given directory, processing all supported source files and overwriting   │
│   them directly with the requested canonical line ending style to ensure consistency.   │
│                                                                                         │
│   Source files are read and rewritten preserving their exact UTF encoding structure,    │
│   supporting UTF-8, UTF-16, and UTF-32, either with or without a Byte Order Mark (BOM). │
│                                                                                         │
│   To prevent data corruption, files with unknown encodings are automatically skipped.   │
│                                                                                         │
│ [!] Disclaimer:                                                                         │
│   This program is distributed 'as-is', without any warranty; Use it at your own risk.   │
│   Ensure to make a backup of your CS/VB files before running this application.          │
╰─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

Usage:
  CS-VB_LINES.exe <directory_path> <line_ending_style> [options]

Mandatory Arguments:
  directory_path       The path to the root directory containing the *.cs or *.vb source-code files to process.
  line_ending_style    The target line ending formatting style to apply. Valid values are: CRLF, LF, CR

Options:
  -r, --recursive      Recursively process source-code files in all subdirectories.
  -t, --test           Runs the application in Test Mode (dry-run), simulating the entire process without modifying actual files.

Examples:
  CS-VB_LI
[truncated]
